arguments.summary: Verify block stripe material matches terrain
arguments.script: System.Collections.IEnumerator Check() { yield return null; yield return null; int count=0; foreach(var r in UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsOfType<UnityEngine.SpriteRenderer>()) if(r.name == "Platform terrain visual") { if(r.sharedMaterial == null || r.sharedMaterial.shader.name != "Terrain/World Rock Flow" || r.sharedMaterial.GetTexture("_FlowTex") == null) throw new System.Exception("Missing stripe material: " + r.name); count++; } UnityEngine.Debug.Log("STRIPED_BLOCKS_PASS " + count); } return Check();
